# better-investment-mcp

> An open-source MCP server that gives AI agents (such as Claude, Cursor and Codex) data on Brazilian assets: prices, dividends, fundamentals, filings, FII reports and macro series. The agent reads everything with one read-only SQL tool over a local DuckDB cache that the server fills on demand.

The server writes only to its own cache file. It exposes four tools: get_overview, get_guide and query_sql (read-only), and notify_load_finish, which sends one POST to an https address the caller gives when a background load finishes (ADR 0028). The output describes and locates information; it is not investment advice. Unofficial: not affiliated with B3, CVM, Yahoo or any other data vendor. Work in progress: the data behind the tools arrives issue by issue.

## Docs

- [GitHub repository and README](https://github.com/guilhermebkel/better-investment-mcp): install, configuration, tools, architecture
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/better-investment-mcp): npx -y better-investment-mcp init
